drug_name: Eucalyptol, Menthol, Methyl Salicylate, and Thymol
what_its_for: This mouth rinse is used to help kill germs in your mouth, fight bad breath, reduce plaque buildup on your teeth, and help prevent gingivitis (gum disease). It works by targeting and destroying the bacteria that can cause these problems.
how_to_take: Pour exactly 20 milliliters (about 4 teaspoons or up to the fill line on the cap) of the rinse into the cap or a measuring cup. Swish it around vigorously in your mouth for a full 30 seconds, then spit it out completely. Do NOT swallow this product. Use it after brushing and flossing your teeth for the best results. Do not eat or drink anything for at least 30 minutes after using the rinse.
dosing: Adults and children 12 years and older: Use 20 mL (about 4 teaspoons) twice daily — once in the morning and once at night. Children under 12 years old should NOT use this product unless directed by a dentist or doctor.
missed_dose: If you forget to use your mouth rinse at your regular time, use it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next scheduled rinse, skip the missed dose and continue with your normal routine. Do not double up by using extra rinse to make up for a missed dose.
storage: Store this product at room temperature, between 59°F and 77°F (15°C and 25°C). Keep the cap tightly closed when not in use. Keep the bottle away from direct sunlight, heat sources, and out of reach of children and pets. Do not freeze. Check the expiration date on the bottle and do not use it after that date.
what_to_avoid: Do not swallow this mouth rinse — it is for external oral use only. Avoid eating, drinking, or smoking for at least 30 minutes after use. Keep this product away from your eyes; if contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with water. Do not dilute the rinse with water unless directed by your dentist, as this may reduce its effectiveness. Avoid use if you are allergic to aspirin or other salicylates, as methyl salicylate is closely related.
when_to_call_doctor: Contact your dentist or doctor if you experience: mouth sores, irritation, pain, or swelling that gets worse or does not go away after a few days; signs of an allergic reaction such as rash, hives, swelling of the face or throat, or difficulty breathing; accidental swallowing of the product, especially in children (call Poison Control at 1-800-222-1222 immediately); or if your gum problems or bad breath do not improve after 2 weeks of regular use.
when_it_works: You may notice fresher breath and a cleaner feeling in your mouth right after the first use. For noticeable improvements in plaque reduction and healthier gums, it typically takes about 2 to 4 weeks of regular twice-daily use. Continue using it consistently for the best long-term results.
special_populations: Children under 12: Do not use without specific guidance from a dentist or doctor due to the risk of accidental swallowing. Pregnant or breastfeeding women: Ask your doctor or dentist before regular use, especially due to the methyl salicylate (salicylate) component. People with aspirin sensitivity or salicylate allergy: Avoid this product as it contains methyl salicylate. People with alcohol sensitivity: Some formulations contain alcohol; look for alcohol-free versions if this is a concern. Elderly patients: Use with caution and follow standard adult instructions; ensure the product is fully spit out and not swallowed.
